workspaces.workingCurrent: Work in progress on the current request
workspaces.startTestNote: Keep this conversation and turn it into a Test session. Nothing will run until you approve it.
workspaces.startTestBusy: Finish the current reply before starting a test.
workspaces.startTestError: Could not start the test. Your conversation is unchanged. Try again.
workspaces.restoreError: Could not restore your workspace. Your saved destination is preserved. Try again.
testSessions.title: What would you like to test?
testSessions.intro: Describe a goal. We’ll prepare a plan together. Nothing runs without your approval.
testSessions.placeholder: Describe a test, ask a question, or discuss a result…
testSessions.chooseProject: Choose a project to save this test
testSessions.viewingPast: You’re viewing an earlier request. New messages still belong to this session.
testSessions.prepareNote: This confirms the goal and prepares a plan. It does not authorize execution.
testSessions.sourceNote: Based on the confirmed brief and selected project context. Chat attachments are not execution evidence.
testSessions.noRunner: Connect your local Runner to prepare the executable plan.
testSessions.prepFailed: Preparation stopped. Your conversation and records are preserved.
testSessions.turnFailed: The assistant could not finish this reply. Your message is saved. Retry explicitly below; an uncertain provider call is never replayed silently.
testSessions.reviewNote: Approve the accuracy of this record, not a release. Failed checks remain failed.
testSessions.externalConfirm: Start a run for a connected agent? This does not dispatch a browser automatically.
testSessions.playwrightTextNote: The bundled Playwright Runner’s TEXT entries report assertion status, completed steps and the first failed step reference, if any—not captured DOM, attributes or logs. Connected agents may provide richer text evidence.
testSessions.emptyChecks: The checklist will appear here after preparation.
testSessions.archived: This session is archived. Restore it to continue.
testSessions.exportNote: Conversation export is not a restorable QA backup. Imported transcripts cannot approve or resume runs.
sessions.syncConflict: This conversation has unsynced or conflicting local changes. They are preserved. Resolve or export them before continuing with server-managed replies.
sessions.draftStorage: Local draft storage is unavailable. Keep this window open or copy your draft before refreshing.
sessions.draftMoveConflict: This session has drafts in both project locations. Copy or clear those drafts before moving it; neither draft was replaced.
testSessions.activePrep: Finish the current preparation or execution before preparing another request.
testSessions.modelNote: Model selection is for conversation. QA preparation uses the configured QA models.
testSessions.errors.request: Could not complete this session request.
testSessions.errors.response: The server returned an invalid session.
testSessions.errors.profiles: Could not load Runner profiles. Retry before preparing or approving a run.
testSessions.errors.newer: The record changed. Refresh and review the current version.
